text_block_list.text:
As I walked down the hallway, I spotted Mejiro Bright
enthusiastically clutching a cleaning rag.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall zoom right through
cleaning the floor around here~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Swish-swish-slash~.
(*sluggish crawl~*)
choice_data_list: (Th-That is the slowest floor mopping ever...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, wiping with a soaking wet rag is quite slow going~.
Let us pick up the pace just a little~.
(*crawling slowly, then flops flat*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, I'm so sorry to worry you.
My foot just slipped a little bit~.

Only a tiny area has been wiped down so far—
It looks like finishing the cleaning
is going to take quite a while longer.
choice_data_list: Want me to lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Fufufu, thank you ever so much
for your thoughtful consideration~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Still, it will be quite alright.
I shall see it through to the end~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Though it may not be my forte, I cannot simply give up so easily.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us gather our spirits and continue.
I do hope I can get the hang of it somehow~.
choice_data_list: Just make sure you don't get hurt.
Just be careful not to get hurt, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us gather our spirits and continue.
I do hope I can get the hang of it somehow~.
choice_data_list: Just make sure you don't get hurt.
Just be careful not to get hurt, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, hearing your kind words of encouragement
has filled me with motivation again~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's try this again—and hup! ♪
(*sluggish crawl~*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your concern~.
Indeed, getting injured and hindering the race
would be putting the cart before the horse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us proceed ever so carefully.
Hup!
(*sluggish crawl~*)

A few days later, while passing through the hallway,
I saw something intensely dazzling!
The reason for that was――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, you're the one from the other day~.
Pardon me for walking ahead~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Swish-swish-swish-slash~.
Mejiro Bright is mopping the floor with brisk, swift movements, completely unlike her usual self!
choice_data_list: Have you been practicing mopping this entire time...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, during cleaning time I wipe down the floors with a rag every day.
And I do a bit of extra practice back at the dorms too~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's finally starting to take a little bit of shape,
but I still have a long way to go~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Since we've come this far, I might as well aim to become a floor-wiping specialist~âª
In the hallway where the polished floors reflected the sunset, Mejiro Bright made her declaration.
